about_short_description.short_description: Appetito is an online delivery startup that delivers grocery and household products using dark stores

product.name: Online Supermarket and Grocery Delivery
product.description: Appetito is an online platform offering delivery of groceries, dairy products, household essentials, vegetables, frozen items, detergents, family care products, bakeries, snacks, and candies.

product.name: Mobile App
product.description: The Appetito mobile app facilitates grocery shopping from local and global brands, offering scheduled or immediate home delivery.

product.name: Payment Options
product.description: Appetito accepts multiple payment methods including cash on delivery, Visa, and Visa on delivery for orders.

product.name: Recipe Sharing Platform
product.description: Appetito provides a collection of various recipes, including oriental, international, and healthy options, through its website and app.

product.name: Customer Service
product.description: Offers customer support through email, live chat in the app, and social media platforms for inquiries, refunds, and order issues.

product.name: Bulk Orders for Companies
product.description: Appetito accommodates bulk order requests for companies, which can be arranged via email communication.
